newsitem.title: UK: NWE JET SLIPS WITH GAS OIL BUT PREMIUMS UNCHANGED.
newsitem.headline: NWE JET SLIPS WITH GAS OIL BUT PREMIUMS UNCHANGED.

text.p: NWE jet fuel prices slipped nearly $2.00 a tonne lower on Thursday on the back of weaker IPE gas oil.
Premiums for physical barges and cargoes of jet against the screen were steady.
Premiums for NWE jet cargoes were pegged around $17.00 above September gas oil for early to mid August delivery while barges were attracting close to $18.00 a tonne above August.
Expectations of Middle East Gulf material heading into NWE in the second half of August was helping keep a lid on barge prices given current tightness.
Traders said contract buying by certain airlines was keeping supplies on the spot market thin.
French, Greek and Italian sellers have become noticeably short of product, traders said.

In the Mediterranean most end-users appear to have picked up their immediate requirements. Italian cargoes have been trading as high as $7.00 over the high fob quotes and Libyan cargoes have been sold out.
